attributes.title: 2027 MTAPA CME Conference
attributes.summary:
The Montana Academy of Physician Assistants meets April 22 to 24, 2027, at the University Center on the University of Montana campus in Missoula. It is a live, in-person meeting open to PAs, NPs, physicians and other clinicians.

MTAPA lists 16.0 credits, to be submitted to AAPA once the agenda is final. Early-bird pricing through January 16, 2027 is $400 for members and $500 for nonmember PAs and NPs (with a year of membership), then $450 and $550. Students pay $50 to $85 and one-day passes are $180 to $200. A courtesy room block at the Holiday Inn Downtown Missoula is $149 per night (code MT7).

Speakers and the agenda are not published yet, and registration has not opened.
